reddit.title: Exciting Updates on Water Mechanics in Provincia!
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to how water interacts with terrain in our game. With native sparse cellular automata, ponds are now cheaper to manage, and terrain modifications like raising lips or digging ditches are smoother than ever. Check out the full details of these changes and how they enhance gameplay here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits

steam.title: Enhancements to Water Mechanics in Provincia
steam.body: We're excited to announce improvements to our water mechanics! For a detailed look at these changes, visit our devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits
